peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (43.4): 2.7 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 114 of 266 similar developments with a figure (the same as 3). Context, not scored: resales in 62.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Lentor MRT about 190 m, Yio Chu Kang MRT about 920 m; closer than 433 of 462 similar developments (the same as 2). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 3 within 2 km; nearest Anderson Primary School about 600 m; more than 59 of 462 similar developments (the same as 182). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 1 supermarket within 1 km (nearest about 960 m), more than 18 of 462 similar developments (the same as 37); nearest hawker centre Ang Mo Kio 628 Market about 490 m; nearest park Teacher's Estate Park about 250 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 5 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Lentoria, 27 new sales, about 210 m; Lentor Mansion, 2 new sales, about 380 m; Hillock Green, 15 new sales, about 430 m; Lentor Gardens Residences, 299 new sales, about 590 m; Lentor Central Residences, 1 new sales, about 600 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 25 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 344 new sales and 174 resales (518 purchases); new sales were 66.4% of these purchases. Subsales (102) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Lentor Central GLS site (Mar 2026) (government land sale site, awarded), about 660 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 174 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 12 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 174 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 177 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−1.7%). Planning-area private resales +12.2%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
